source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of vascular disorders and stroke (PDF 49-50).

blocks.text: Nervous system ki vascular (khoon ki nalyon wali) bimariyan woh halatein hain jin mein dimagh aur spinal cord ki khoon ki nalyan mutasir hoti hain. Misalein stroke aur cerebral venous thrombosis (dimagh ki vein mein khoon ka lothra) hain.
